goal: Create a self-contained 3D neon portal web demo with a software 3D renderer on <canvas id="c">, two-tier platform, twin pillars, lintel, crown cap (36 box faces), 6 orbiting octahedral crystals (48 triangles), portal core with 2 counter-rotating rings, cyber grid floor, 180 twinkling stars, 110 rising particles, orbiting camera, and glassmorphism HUD with live stats and interactive controls.
constraints: Self-contained 3D neon portal web demo in index.html (or index.html + engine3d.js + scene.js + app.js) using software 3D rendering on <canvas id="c">.
Full-viewport <canvas id="c"> (100vw x 100vh, overflow:hidden) with dark radial-gradient space background (#0b1026 center to #03040e edge).
Software 3D renderer: 3D-to-2D perspective projection, rotation matrices, painter's algorithm z-sorting, back-face culling, and diffuse/rim shading.
Portal monument built from 6 boxes (36 box faces): two-tier stepped platform, twin pillars, lintel beam, and crown cap in dark slate with neon cyan edges.
Six orbiting octahedral crystals (8 triangles each = 48 triangles) revolving around the portal in glowing magenta (#ff2ad4) and cyan (#00f0ff) facets.
Portal core at center with glowing radial vortex energy and two counter-rotating 3D neon rings (cyan #00f0ff and magenta #ff2ad4).
Cyber grid floor beneath the platform with perspective neon grid lines fading into distance, 180 twinkling stars, and 110 rising glowing particles.
Orbiting camera with smooth auto-orbit around Y axis plus pointer drag orbit and wheel zoom.
Glassmorphism HUD overlay (backdrop-filter blur, translucent dark panel, subtle neon border) titled "NEON PORTAL 3D".
HUD displays live #fps, #polys (polygon count >= 84), and #parts (110 particles) counters.
Button #btn-pause toggles animation pause/resume and updates its label between "Pause" and "Resume".
Button #btn-orbit toggles camera auto-orbit and updates its label between "Orbit ON" and "Orbit OFF".
Range slider #speed (min="0.1" max="3" step="0.1" value="1") scales animation and rotation speed.
Button #btn-reset restores default camera angle/zoom, sets #speed to 1, unpauses ("Pause"), and enables auto-orbit ("Orbit ON").
No external CDN dependencies, no network fetches, and zero console errors on load or interaction.
